required_fixes: Fix B-FLASK-ONLY baseline degeneracy: flask_only_server.py has zero behavioral variance (all behavioral_delta=0, std=0, n=480) because it implements no auth/token validation. Fix by adding simple token_state variation (valid/expired via query param or header) so behavioral_delta varies, allowing pearson r to be defined. Current B-FLASK-ONLY r=NaN marked C6_baseline_flask_only PASS trivially is invalid; prereg 4.2 and spec measurement_validity #7 require B-FLASK-ONLY baseline with genuine behavioral variation and same headers-only extraction.

Fix residual V2 shared-variable confound in structural signal: structural_composite includes request_id_entropy and dynamic_content_hash derived from request_id. Valid-token responses use UUID (36-char) for request_id, expired-token 401 responses use secrets.token_hex(8) (16-hex) fallback, and 304 responses use empty-body fallback. Recomputed: valid entropy mean 3.542 vs expired mean 3.233, t=13.40 p=2.7e-34; valid structural mean 0.4056 vs expired 0.3539, t=3.86 p=0.00013. This creates definitional non-independence. Fix by using single deterministic request_id generator (e.g., UUID v4 for all paths) independent of status code, or exclude request_id_entropy/dynamic hash from structural signal and use only ETag/Cache-Control variation, or include only success-path 2xx request_ids with identical generation.

Correct C5_304_exercised control definition: spec.json and prereg 7.1 C5 require symmetric heterogeneity check (|r_cache_enabled - r_cache_disabled| < 2*SE), not 304 rate >=10%. Producer implements rate check (observed 0.3167) and reports PASS, but per-cache r values are -0.2696 vs -0.0914 (diff 0.178) with SE 0.0458, 2*SE=0.0916, so diff exceeds threshold. Align control to frozen prereg or amend spec explicitly.

Correct outcome labeling and C3/C4 interpretation: producer outcome MIXED with C3 test 'CI upper <0.15' but implemented full equivalence (both bounds within +/-0.15). With recomputed pooled r=-0.1737, CI [-0.259,-0.085], lower bound -0.259 < -0.15 and abs(r)=0.173 >0.15, so orthogonality at delta=0.15 is REJECTED per spec falsifier (1). Report.md claim 'B-FLASK-ONLY r=nan supports hypothesis' is invalid; NaN is uninformative, not support. Outcome should be FALSIFIES/REJECTED for testbed, with C6 indeterminate.

Correct null_control reporting: result.json metrics null_control_mean=3.5 std=3.5 reflects behavioral_delta, not structural signal on cache-disabled responses. Spec null_control requires structural invariance check. Fix provenance and validity_notes to report actual structural std per cache mode.

claim_ceiling: C-FRESHNESS orthogonality at delta=0.15 is FALSIFIED on this production-like local testbed (Flask 3.1.3, PyJWT RS256, SQLite WAL, CDN ETag/Cache-Control, jitter 10-100ms, n=480) with the implemented headers-only structural definition: pooled r=-0.1737 (|r|=0.1737), 95% CI [-0.259,-0.085] excludes 0 and exceeds equivalence bounds, per-endpoint r up to -0.51. However the falsification is CONFOUNDED by definitional leakage (request_id source differs by token state) and B-FLASK-ONLY baseline is invalid (NaN), so no inference is justified that infrastructure (CDN/OAuth/dynamic content) per se breaks orthogonality, nor that headers-only in principle fails. Maximum justified ceiling: on this specific local testbed and this specific flawed headers-only implementation, orthogonality does NOT hold; the prior localhost-mock confirmation (r=0.0022-0.046, EXP-GRAPH-35389145821) remains the only clean baseline. No advancement of C-FRESHNESS toward VALIDATED; status remains EXPERIMENTAL bounded to stochastic mock. Do not promote to Product Core.
unresolved: Whether orthogonality would hold with a truly independent headers-only definition (single request_id generator for all status codes, or ETag/Cache-Control only) - requires re-run after V1 fix
Whether B-FLASK-ONLY baseline shows |r|<0.15 when given genuine behavioral variation - requires rebuilding baseline with token-state variation
Whether the observed -0.17 correlation is driven entirely by request_id entropy bifurcation vs residual infrastructure (CDN cache invalidation, OAuth) - requires ablation isolating entropy component
Whether per-cache heterogeneity (-0.269 vs -0.091) is sampling noise or systematic cache-behavior interaction - requires larger n or stratified test
Generalization to distributed production, non-Flask frameworks, concurrent load, and real-world structural signal formulations remains untested
